title: Strings
test_conventions: Tests are Python assert snippets executed AFTER the learner's code, in the same namespace, one snippet at a time. Everything the learner's code printed is available to tests as the string variable __stdout__. expected_output comparisons are exact after stripping trailing whitespace on each line (and trailing blank lines). tests[].visible defaults to true; visible:false tests are hidden and always carry a failure_message. For fill_blank, blanks in starter_code are written ___ and are filled in order; every alternative in blanks[].answer must pass the tests. For parsons, lines are shown shuffled; correct_order lists, for each position of the solution, the index into lines; distractors are extra lines that must not be used. For predict, expected_output must be one of choices; for debug with expected_output the fixed program's stdout must match it exactly. The learner source code is available to tests as the string __source__.

exercises.explanation: :.2f inside the braces rounds the float to 2 digits after the decimal point.

misconceptions.4 / 3 = 1.3333333333333333: :.2f limits the number to two decimals; without it you would see the long float.
misconceptions.4 / 3 = 1.3: The 2 in .2f means two digits after the point, not one.
misconceptions.4 / 3 = 1: / is true division, so the value is 1.333..., which .2f formats as 1.33.

exercises.explanation_tr: Süslü parantez içindeki :.2f, ondalık sayıyı virgülden sonra 2 basamağa yuvarlar.

misconceptions_tr.4 / 3 = 1.3: .2f içindeki 2, virgülden sonra iki basamak demektir, bir değil.
misconceptions_tr.4 / 3 = 1: / gerçek bölmedir, değer 1.333... olur; .2f bunu 1.33 olarak biçimler.

notes: Counting starts at 0; -1 is the last character.
A slice [start:stop] stops BEFORE the stop index.
notes_tr: [başlangıç:bitiş] diliminde bitiş indeksi DAHİL değildir, ondan önce durur.

exercises.explanation: [1:4] takes indexes 1, 2, 3 = 'rag'. A step of -1 reverses. [-3:] takes the last three characters, 'gon'.

misconceptions.dra\nnogard\ngon: Index 0 is 'd'. [1:4] starts at index 1, so it begins with 'r'.
misconceptions.rago\ndragon\nagon: The stop index is excluded, and [::-1] reverses the text.
misconceptions.rag\nnogard\ndra: [-3:] counts from the END: the last three letters.

exercises.explanation_tr: [1:4] 1, 2, 3 numaralı indeksleri alır: 'rag'. -1 adımı metni ters çevirir. [-3:] son üç karakteri alır: 'gon'.

misconceptions_tr.dra\nnogard\ngon: 0. indeks 'd'dir. [1:4] 1. indeksten başlar, yani 'r' ile başlar.
misconceptions_tr.rago\ndragon\nagon: Bitiş indeksi dahil değildir ve [::-1] metni ters çevirir.
misconceptions_tr.rag\nnogard\ndra: [-3:] SONDAN sayar: son üç harfi verir.

solution.approach: Use an index, a negative index, a slice and a reversing slice.

notes: split() turns a string into a list of words.
'sep'.join(list) glues a list of strings back together.
notes_tr: split() bir string'i kelime listesine çevirir.

exercises.explanation: Splitting on commas gives 3 items. join('+') glues them with a plus. strip() removes the spaces on both ends before the '!' is added.

misconceptions.3\nHTML+CSS+JS\n hi !: strip() removes the spaces at both ends of 'hi'.
misconceptions.1\nHTML+CSS+JS\nhi!: split(',') cuts at every comma, so you get 3 pieces.
misconceptions.3\nHTML,CSS,JS\nhi!: The join separator is '+', so the pieces are glued with plus signs.

exercises.explanation_tr: Virgülden bölmek 3 parça verir. join('+') parçaları artıyla birleştirir. strip() '!' eklenmeden önce baştaki ve sondaki boşlukları siler.

misconceptions_tr.3\nHTML+CSS+JS\n hi !: strip() 'hi' kelimesinin iki ucundaki boşlukları siler.
misconceptions_tr.1\nHTML+CSS+JS\nhi!: split(',') her virgülden keser, yani 3 parça elde edersin.
misconceptions_tr.3\nHTML,CSS,JS\nhi!: join ayracı '+' olduğu için parçalar artı işaretiyle birleşir.

exercises.prompt: In your own words: why does 'Python'[0:3] give 'Pyt' and not 'Pyth'?

exercises.model_answer: Indexing starts at 0 and the stop index in a slice is excluded. [0:3] takes the characters at index 0, 1 and 2, which are P, y and t.
exercises.model_answer_tr: İndeksleme 0'dan başlar ve dilimde bitiş indeksi dahil değildir. [0:3] 0, 1 ve 2. indeksteki karakterleri alır: P, y ve t.
